title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Billing Desk Note: Review Window for Counting Expedited Fees
content:
## Billing desk guidance: the expedite review window

**Rule.** For a Home Delivery Pharmacy account, the review window for the frequent-expedite discount depends on how long the account has been open on the handling date: for an account open 60 whole months or more the window covers expedited fees dated less than 24 whole months before the handling date, for an account open less than 12 whole months it covers those dated less than 6 whole months before, and for every other account it covers those dated less than 12 whole months before.

How long the account has been open is counted in whole months from the account's opened date to the handling date.

### Window by months open

| Whole months the account has been open on the handling date | Expedited fees counted are those dated less than |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 24 whole months before the handling date |
| 12 through 59 | 12 whole months before the handling date |
| fewer than 12 | 6 whole months before the handling date |

### Boundary pairs (hypothetical accounts)

- Open 60 whole months: 24-month window. Open 59 whole months: 12-month window.
- Open 12 whole months: 12-month window. Open 11 whole months: 6-month window.

### Reading "less than N whole months before"

An expedited fee belongs to a 12-month window when fewer than 12 whole months separate its date from the handling date; a fee dated exactly 12 whole months before the handling date falls outside that window.
